Plugin.Name: Dockhook
Plugin.Overview: Exposes an HTTP endpoint on the Unraid host so a CI pipeline (e.g. GitLab CI) can trigger a Docker container update after a new image is pushed. update_container pulls the new image and recreates the container from its Unraid template, so it keeps its icon, ports, volumes and GUI integration; restart_container does a plain restart; run_userscript runs a User Scripts entry. Requests are authenticated with a shared token compared in constant time, and are restricted to an allowlist of named targets configured on the settings page - no path, image name or command from a request ever reaches a shell.
